companies.sector: Retail - value supermarkets/hypermarkets (food & grocery, FMCG, general merchandise & apparel)
companies.description: Mumbai-based retailer that owns and operates DMart stores under an everyday-low-cost / everyday-low-price model, selling foods, non-food FMCG and general merchandise & apparel. It had 500 stores and 20.6 million sq ft of retail business area at 31 Mar 2026 and 518 stores / 21.4 million sq ft at 30 Sep 2026, across 17 listed states/regions. E-commerce (DMart Ready) runs through subsidiary Avenue E-Commerce Ltd (18 cities at 31 Mar 2026). CIN L51900MH2000PLC126473.

market_share_estimates.notes: Broker estimate, approximate; market-size basis and year not stated in the summary. No research-firm estimate of DMart's share of organised grocery retail was found.

market_data_snapshot.notes: Snapshot, not live. NSE 'As on 16-Oct-2026 16:00 IST' close 3,342.00; 'Total Market Cap (Rs Cr.) 2,18,001.84'. BSE showed the same close and full market cap. 52-week range 3,322.20-4,644.00 (NSE).

data_gaps: Employees recorded for FY2026 only (BRSR); earlier years not collected.
EBITDA is the company's press-release figure rounded to INR crore (definition: PBT + D&A + finance costs - other income); not an audited line item.
gross_profit is DERIVED (revenue - purchases - change in inventories); DMart does not report gross profit as a line item.
Store count, retail area, revenue per sq ft and employees are standalone; financial metrics are consolidated.
Capex line wording changed from FY2024 onward (now includes CWIP, capital advances and capital creditors, net) - not strictly comparable with FY2020-FY2023.
Market share: only a broker estimate of share of total Indian retail; no named-research-firm share of organised grocery retail found.
Interim results (Q1/Q2 FY2027) are not recorded as observations; see news_seed.
The store POS/ERP vendor is not disclosed in the filings reviewed (SAP ERP use is confirmed in a May 2026 filing; the store POS vendor is not).

companies.sector: Retail - home improvement / value variety stores
companies.description: Malaysian value retailer of home-improvement and everyday household products operating MR D.I.Y. and sub-brand stores in Malaysia and Brunei (1,584 stores at 31 Dec 2025 including KKV and sub-brands; 1,610 stores at 30 Jun 2026 per press reports). Listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia since 26 Oct 2020. MR D.I.Y.-branded operations elsewhere (e.g. Singapore) are run by related companies outside the listed group, per the related-party disclosures in the 2025 annual report. Company no. 201001034084 (918007-M).

securities.notes: Bursa 'Initial Public Offering' listing announcement (23 Oct 2020) mirrored on the company IR site; stock code and name also confirmed on Bursa's company profile page.

companies.reporting_basis: MFRS / IFRS; consolidated Group figures, audited, in RM'000 as presented (EBITDA in RM million as presented by the company).
